meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把标题、数据或地图变成动态短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想做会动的标题、图表或地图,又不想学专业软件
copy.tagline_en: Turn headlines, data, or maps into short animated videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to bring titles, charts, or maps to life without learning pro software.

howto.what: Claude会自主制作通常10秒内的设计型动态图形（如动感文字、数字滚动、图表动画等），历经规划、素材搜索、设计、构建、验证后渲染为MP4或透明视频。全程最多问一次“先预览还是直接渲染”。
howto.when: 当用户提出制作通常10秒内、无旁白的设计型动态图形，如文字动画、数字滚动、图表动效等时触发。若素材来自Figma链接，会先调/figma；若需求更长、有旁白或多场景则转/general-video。

say.text: 把这句话做成动感文字动画，10秒内。
say.note: Claude会创建项目并规划镜头，然后构建动画。

say.text: 用这组数据做一个柱状图动画，渲染成MP4。
say.note: 会规划图表分类，构建并验证。

say.text: 给这个logo做一个片头动效，5秒。
say.note: 会走logo-reveal类别，生成品牌锁屏动画。

howto.what_en: Claude autonomously creates a short design-led motion graphic (e.g. kinetic type, stat count-up, chart animation) under 10s: plans, sources assets, designs, builds, verifies, renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Asks 'preview or render?' at most once.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants a short (≤10s), unnarrated design-led motion graphic (e.g. kinetic type, stat count-up, chart animation). Figma URLs run /figma first; longer/narrated/multi-scene requests go to /general-video.
